note: The one next step a report suggests, by number and direction. Plain advice the member acts on; nothing here changes an account. {product}, {post}, {ad}, {value} and {avg} are filled from the member's own numbers.

down.sales: Send one offer today to people who already bought: an email or a post about {product}, your best seller lately.
down.orders: Post or send one clear offer today: {product}, with the price and one link to buy.
down.aov: Add one small add-on next to {product} at checkout, or a bundle of two, and see if the average order comes back.
down.cash_in: Look at the refunds and fees lines first: they moved more than sales did.
down.ad_results: Open your ads and check {ad} first: it spent the most for the fewest results.
down.click_rate: Test a new first line or first picture on {ad}. That is where most people decide to click.
down.ad_return: Check {ad}: pause it in your ads account if it keeps spending without sales.
down.posts: Post once today. Reuse {post}, your best post lately, with a new first line.
down.post_views: Post a video today in the style of {post}, your best post lately.
down.engagement: End your next post with one question people can answer in a word.
down.follows: Make your next post the kind of thing people save: a how-to like {post}.
down.custom: Look at what you did on your best day for {name} and do it again today.

up_bad.refunds: Read the reasons on the newest refunds. If they name one product or one promise, fix that listing today.
up_bad.refund_rate: Read the reasons on the newest refunds. If they name one product or one promise, fix that listing today.
up_bad.chargebacks: Answer the chargeback in your payment account with the order details and any delivery proof, before its due date.
up_bad.fees: Check where the fees came from: many small card payments cost more than a few big ones.
up_bad.cost_per_result: Check {ad}: it cost the most per result. If it keeps costing more per result than a sale is worth to you for 3 more days, pause it in your ads account.
up_bad.ad_spend: Check that the extra ad spend brought results: {ad} spent the most.
up_bad.custom: {name} went up. Check it was planned.

up.sales: Do yesterday again: {why} Post or send the same thing today while it is working.
up.orders: Do yesterday again: {why} Post or send the same thing today while it is working.
up.aov: Keep whatever lifted the average order: {why}
up.ad_results: {ad} is doing best. If it stays under your target cost for 3 more days, raise its budget about 20% in your ads account.
up.post_views: {post} is pulling views. Post a follow-up today that answers the top comment on it.
up.follows: New follows came in. Pin {post} so new people see your best work first.
up.default: Keep going. Nothing on your scorecard needs fixing today.

dispute_sources: Stripe: Measuring disputes, https://docs.stripe.com/disputes/measuring (checked 2026-10-20): 'The credit card processing industry standard recognizes dispute activity above 0.75% as excessive' and cardholders can dispute 'up to 120 days after a payment was made'.
